Here is the data and context you need to write the thread:

        MARKET DATA:
        - ASX 200 closed last week at 8,522.5 points
        - Wall Street: S&P 500 closed at 5,659.91, Dow Jones at 40,861.45, Nasdaq at 17,928.92
        - AUD/USD: 0.6418
        - US 10-year yield: 4.51%
        - Gold: $3,294.49 per ounce
        - Oil (WTI): $66.74 per barrel
        - Iron ore: $97.30 per tonne
        - Copper: $4.26 per lb
        - Bitcoin: $101,765
        - VIX: 18.10

        MACRO THEMES:
        - US-China trade tensions simmering: 30-day tariff truce expires August 12
        - RBA expected to hold rates at 3.85% at August 12 meeting
        - US CPI data due August 13 — market expects 2.7% YoY
        - Australian Wage Price Index due August 20
        - Iron ore under pressure as China steel demand outlook weakens

        SECTOR NOTES:
        - Banks: Reporting season in full swing; CBA result due August 13
        - Materials: Iron ore at $97.30/t, copper holding at $4.26/lb
        - Energy: WTI at $66.74/bbl, weighing on energy sector sentiment
        - Gold miners: Gold at $3,294.49/oz supporting gold stocks
        - Property/REITs: Rate hold expected to provide near-term support

        

Post 1

ASX 200 at 8,522.5 — but the next 48hrs could reprice everything. The 30-day US-China tariff truce expires Aug 12, same day the RBA decides. Directional view: cautious. Two binary events, one session. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2

🏦 Banks face CBA earnings Aug 13 — the bellwether print for the sector. 🪙 Gold miners get a tailwind from $3,294/oz spot. Two sectors, two very different catalysts this week. #ASX #banking #gold

Post 3

🔻 Iron ore at $97.30/t is the number to watch in materials. China's steel demand outlook is deteriorating — miners trading near a line in the sand. A break below $95 changes the conversation fast. #ASX #ironore #mining

Post 4

S&P 500 closed at 5,659.91 with VIX at 18.10 — not fearful, not complacent. US CPI lands Aug 13; market pricing 2.7% YoY. A hot print lifts the USD, pressures AUD from 0.6418, and hits rate-sensitive ASX names. #ASX #ausbiz #inflation

Post 5

Aug 12: RBA decision + tariff truce expiry on the same day. Hold at 3.85% is consensus — but any hawkish tilt crushes REITs. Tariff breakdown hits miners hard. Both surprise? ASX opens ugly. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz
